resources.string: Give it a name, e.g. “Qidian covers”
Source folder (images are moved from here)
Tap “Choose” on the right and start from /sdcard
Not set yet. Tap “Choose”, start at /sdcard and open folders until you reach the one with your images
This is the whole storage root — nearly every image on the phone will be moved
This is the data root of every app, so images from all apps will be moved; tap “Choose” and drill down to the app you want
Starting from /sdcard, drill down to the exact image folder — that is the safest
Moves images from every level under the source folder
; note the target folder is inside the source, so files just moved there will be picked up as source again
Only moves images directly in the source folder, subfolders are ignored (safer when the target is inside the source)
Put it under DCIM or Pictures so the gallery shows files right away
Move: source files are moved into the target folder (recommended)
Copy: source files stay, a copy goes to the target folder (try this on day one)
“{app}” = use the source app name automatically (cover_{app}.png → cover_Qidian.png); your own text = a fixed suffix (e.g. _Shitu); blank = keep the original file name
Name files by content instead (15 letters/digits)
The same file always gets the same name, so duplicates are never stored twice.\nExample: K7pQ2mVx9Rb4TzW%1$s.jpg (the suffix follows what you set above)
Off: the target keeps the original name and only gets the suffix you set
A few things are still missing
Fill in: %1$s.\n\nFor folders, tap “Choose” and open them one by one from /sdcard; the name is up to you, just make it easy to recognize.
Save this setup so you can apply it in one tap next time you create a rule (saving a template does not save this rule).

Your source is %1$s and the target %2$s is inside it. Files already moved will not be moved again (the app skips the target folder automatically), but it is clearer and easier to undo if you put the target outside the source. Save it this way anyway?

You picked /sdcard (the whole phone storage) as the source. After saving, nearly every image on the phone will be moved by this rule (in Move mode the originals leave their place). If you only want to tidy up one app, go back and open Android/data/<package>/… and pick a folder inside.
